test_modes.name: PAM3 transmitter test patterns
test_modes.purpose: Emissions + jitter compliance per OPEN-Alliance EMC spec.

test_modes.name: Master/slave force
test_modes.purpose: Force a role to characterise the channel / cable.

spec_provided_observability.name: SNR readout (MDIO)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Signal-to-noise ratio at the slicer for in-system link-quality monitoring.

spec_provided_observability.name: MSE readout (MDIO)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Mean-squared error after echo cancellation + equalisation; the link-up / health metric.

spec_provided_observability.name: Master/slave config + resolved-role status
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Verify the two ends have opposite roles.

spec_provided_observability.name: PLCA status counters (10BASE-T1S)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Beacon seen, collision-free, per-node transmit-opportunity accounting.

spec_provided_observability.name: Transmitter test patterns (PMA)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: PAM3 test modes for emissions + jitter compliance.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: BMSR bit 1.2 transitions 1→0 (link down) or 0→1 (link up) — many PHYs route this to an open-drain INT# pin.
BMSR bit 1.5 transitions to 1 after AutoNeg finishes.
10BASE-T jabber timer expiration; BMSR bit 1.1 set.
Vendor-specific Energy Efficient Ethernet wake event (Clause 78).
MAC Control sublayer recognises a valid 0x8808 / opcode 0x0001 frame; MAC stalls TX for the indicated pause quanta.
Half-duplex MAC TX FSM aborts after 16 retries — raises a MAC-error indication.
Per-frame error indication from the receive MAC.

loopback_modes_summary.name: Near-end MAC loopback
loopback_modes_summary.scope: MAC TX → MAC RX inside the MAC; PHY not exercised.

loopback_modes_summary.name: PCS loopback (BMCR 0.14)
loopback_modes_summary.scope: MII / GMII TX path → MII / GMII RX path inside the PHY; medium not driven.

loopback_modes_summary.name: PMA / PMD loopback
loopback_modes_summary.scope: Vendor-specific; loops back on the analog side of the PHY (e.g. after the MLT-3 encoder).

loopback_modes_summary.name: External cable loopback
loopback_modes_summary.scope: Physical RJ-45 / fiber loopback plug at the MDI; exercises the entire TX + RX analog chain.

notes: Single-pair PHYs rely on SNR/MSE as the primary in-system health instrument, plus PAM3 transmitter test patterns for automotive EMC compliance and PLCA status for 10BASE-T1S multidrop. The OPEN Alliance publishes interoperability + EMC test specifications. JTAG / scan / BIST are vendor-added.
